title: Sunspear armor
wikitext:
*'''Standard:''' Crafted by [[Mehinu]] in [[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan]]; [[Pasu]] in [[Jokanur Diggings (outpost)|Jokanur Diggings]]; [[Sulee]] in [[Blacktide Den (outpost)|Blacktide Den]]; [[Vatundo]] in [[Consulate Docks (outpost)|Consulate Docks]]; and [[Burreh]] in [[Command Post]].
**Available as PvP armor for Paragons and Dervishes.
*'''Elite:''' Crafted by [[Ahamid]] in [[Command Post]] after completing [[Building the Base: Prisoners of War]].  '''(Not available for Assassins and Ritualists).'''
*'''Hero:''' Crafted by [[Bahldasareh]] in [[Dajkah Inlet (outpost)|Dajkah Inlet]] for one [[Stolen Sunspear Armor]].
